title: Learning Spectral-Decomposited Tokens for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Rein-like learnable tokens split by frequency band so low-frequency style and high-frequency content are tuned apart.
adaptation: Cracks are high frequency; scuff streaks and source contrast are low frequency. One arm on VFM-H replacing Rein tokens.
min_experiment: Arm: VFM-H + spectral tokens. Baseline: VFM-H + Rein. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, E1 false alarms on scuff cells. Kill: not +0.02 E1 relF1@2.
